sn55.14:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sabbaduggatibhayam samatikkanto hoti ||
sn55.14:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.14:1.4: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn55.14:1.7: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgāto hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || 8.
sn55.14:1.8: Ime hi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sabbaduggatibhayaṃ samatikkanto hotī
